IncidentBot: [ALERT] realtime-latency-regression fired for streaming.generate v2 — region=us-west-2 — p99=1900ms (baseline ~320ms), p95=420ms. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/d/latency/stream?orgId=1&var-region=us-west-2. Paging on-call.
Sophia (oncall): acknowledged. I'm oncall for this window, joining. @channel pls post quick checks (deploys, autoscale, KV cache) before we page escalation.
Maria R: seeing the alert too. Multiple streaming sessions dropped around 2024-08-12T15:22Z. Error rate spike ~0.9% for streaming endpoints.
IncidentBot: PagerDuty page created: PD12345 -> paging @Liam K. Incident record: INC-5678.
Liam K: picked up PD12345. Quick triage plan: 1) confirm recent deploys 2) check autoscale events & infra metrics 3) check KV cache evictions and batch sizing 4) run a live tail request. Anyone ran a deploy in the last 3 hours?
Ramon G: no deploys in last 3h from release pipeline. Not seeing config rollouts. I do see a surge in autoscaler churn around 15:20Z — nodes flapping (scale up / down cycles). Also increased KV cache evictions on host-gpu-*. Possibly cache pressure when many large-context streams hit at once.
Maria R: running logs now. sample tail from one replica:
```
2024-08-12T15:21:58Z INFO stream-gen request_id=abc123 start seq_len=128
2024-08-12T15:22:01Z WARN kvcache eviction key=prefix:usr:98765 reason=mem_pressure
2024-08-12T15:22:02Z ERROR stream-gen request_id=abc124 stall=1200ms stage=kv-lookup
2024-08-12T15:22:03Z INFO stream-gen request_id=abc125 finish latency=1900ms
```
Sophia (oncall): running quick curl against the streaming endpoint to measure latency tail (test client in us-west-2):
```
# measuring simple streaming start->first-chunk latency
time curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.prod/streaming.generate -d '{"prompt":"long context...","max_tokens":800}'
# result: real 1.78s, p95 ~430ms locally matches dashboard
```
Liam K: p95 is near normal, p99 elevated = classic tail stall. The logs show KV evictions + stalls on kv-lookup. Likely pattern: large-context (>=512-1024 tokens) requests cause eviction churn and batch stalls, exacerbated by recent traffic burst.
InfraBot: detected node churn event: autoscaler triggered 12 scale events between 15:18-15:24 UTC for pool=inference-usw2-gpu. Recent GC/OOM events on 3 nodes.
Ramon G: I'm enabling defensive mitigations we can do immediately:
- reduce max_batch_size from 64 -> 32 for streaming.generate on inference pool (low-risk config flip)
- temporarily disable prefix/KV caching for streaming route:streaming.generate (falls back to unchached path)
- shift 20% of traffic to us-east-1 fallback (route weight change)
Applying batch-size change now.
Liam K: ACK. I'll coordinate traffic reweighting and watch p99 in Grafana. Maria — can you confirm customer impact in support queue?
Maria R: support-bot shows 4 customer tickets in last 15m referencing slow streaming responses; estimated impacted sessions ~0.7% with retries, 2.3% of requests saw >1.5s. No major paying customer outage reported yet, but streaming UX degraded.
support-bot: Alert created in support: SUP-3421. Notifying account teams for customers who reported degraded streaming.
Sophia (oncall): mitigation status: batch-size change applied -> infra reports batch config change successful on pool inference-usw2-gpu. Now flipping caching off for streaming path.
Liam K: initiating traffic weight shift -> route control API:
```
POST https://control-plane.internal/v1/route/streaming.generate/reweight
{ "from": "us-west-2", "to": "us-east-1", "percent": 20 }
```
Response: 202 accepted.
IncidentBot: action logged: INC-5678 -> mitigation steps: batch_size_reduce, cache_disable, traffic_shift_20pct.
Ramon G: autoscaler stabilization in progress, reducing node churn by pinning min_replicas to current count for 10m. Also increasing eviction threshold temp.
Maria R: monitoring support tickets and error rates. Current customer impact summary for handoff: ~0.7% sessions retried, 4 tickets, no SLA breaches opened yet at account level but SLO p99 breached for 12m window.
Liam K: Observing p99 drop from 1.9s -> 700ms after mitigations. Still above baseline but trending down. Will keep traffic shift in place for 30m and watch for regressions. If p99 not back to baseline in 15m, plan is rollback to previous model variant (smaller model) for streaming.generate and enable canary route.
Sophia (oncall): good work. Logging timeline and assigning follow-up: postmortem required (owner: Liam K). Oncall handoff: I'll remain here for 30 more minutes then hand off to Ramon G at 16:10Z. Please keep incident channel updated with any customer escalations.
Liam K: creating post-incident checklist and initial notes in INC-5678. Will capture KV cache TTL tuning, autoscaler gating, batching SLO tests. Adding runbook item: preflight check for large-context traffic pattern.
Ramon G: monitoring infra metrics. If we see new node OOMs or eviction spikes, I'll spin up an emergency reserve pool and drain affected nodes.
IncidentBot: Incident INC-5678 mitigation steps recorded. Next update scheduled in 10m or on status changes. If anyone needs paging escalation, use PD12345.
Sophia (oncall): handing off active watch to Ramon G in 30m unless issues persist. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
